details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which sends an HTTP POST of a JSON body containing the package name, hostname, install path, working directory, npm/node user agent and protocol to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with an X-Beacon-Package header. index.js fires the same beacon when the module is required and exports a no-op Proxy shim so that a build importing the real package name completes instead of crashing. The package collects no credentials, tokens, environment values or file contents; the only data transmitted is the install-time host and path metadata listed above.
